title: System Design
description: Learn system design step by step: functional and non-functional requirements, characterizing a problem, and weighing the trade-offs behind every design choice.

chapters.title: Functional Requirements
chapters.description: What must the system do? Discover, write and check functional requirements, then use them in design and interviews.

chapters.title: Non-Functional Requirements
chapters.description: How well must the system work? Make qualities such as availability, latency and security measurable, weigh trade-offs, and use them in design and interviews.

chapters.title: Requirement Characterization
chapters.description: Understand the problem before designing: classify requirements along 13 dimensions, from workload and state to trust, geography and tenancy, and reason about their consequences.

chapters.title: System Design Trade-offs
chapters.description: Choose a design from requirements and explain what it gives up: fourteen core trade-offs, decision records, case studies, interview answers and a full workbook.
